name: provider-failure-mid-stream
description: Journey #8 (docs/RELIABILITY_ARCHITECTURE.md §5, §9; task D1): a Summarizer node streams from the harness's fault-capable cassette provider (`reliability-fault-llm`, wired by `faults/provider-faults.ts`). Run once per fault in the matrix below (via `nodetool reliability run provider-failure-mid-stream --faults <name>`, or the harness's own `tests/journeys/provider-failure-mid-stream.test.ts`): the immediate faults (429/500/timeout) and the mid-stream faults (truncated-stream, malformed-sse) end the run with a terminal `job_update failed` and a sane error; slow-drip and cost-omission complete normally, just slower / with no usage. Every fault's record must pass the declared invariants with zero violations and leave no orphan actors.
